# jsDelivr's npm mirror (cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jquery-color@2.2.0/dist/

# (base64 aSe2ZC5QeunlL/w/7PsVKmV+fa0eDbmybn/ptsKHR6I=) instead of cdnjs SRI.
